title: Tensor and internal Hom by the actual scalar-extended Kummer line
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, and T a noetherian scheme on which l is invertible. For every existing Chern data c [def-sp-tower-class-chern], the actual sheaf lineModule obtained by scalar extension of its rootModule admits Twisting [def-sp-tower-class-twisting]: tensor by that very line is an additive exact equivalence whose inverse is internal Hom from that same line, with the specified coevaluation, evaluation and coefficient-unit formulas. No existence or normalization of Chern morphisms is asserted.

source.place: clause (2), local rank-one root module and scalar extension; sk-prop-diagonal-tower/_section.md, Tate-twist paragraph

proof.text: Apply kummerRoot_rank_one to c.reduction.forget, c.rootModule and c.rootForget. This establishes rank one for the integral module, independently of every derived Chern arrow. Scalar extension preserves invertibility by scalarExtensionDual_localIsomorphism. The two sectionwise change-of-rings constructions agree; c.scalar.model.obj_eq identifies their value with exactly lineModule. Transport invertibility along this equality and use the rank-one/invertible equivalence.

source.place: clause (2), local rank-one root module and scalar extension; sk-prop-diagonal-tower/_section.md, Tate-twist paragraph

proof.text: Form the actual right adjoint homFunctor(lineModule) on the ringed sequence site. SiteTensorHom.equiv supplies its tensor/Hom bijection; equiv_naturality and a componentwise computation prove the two naturality equations. Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv therefore gives the ordinary adjunction with the fixed tensor functor positive. The local rank-one criterion gives a covering sieve of unit trivializations. Apply evaluation_inverse_pair to obtain an isomorphism from lineModule tensor its actual internal dual to the unit. BraidedCategory.tensorRightEquivalence and siteSheafTensorRightIso show that positive is an equivalence.

source.place: clause (2), local rank-one root module and scalar extension; sk-prop-diagonal-tower/_section.md, Tate-twist paragraph

proof.text: Upgrade that very adjunction by Adjunction.toEquivalence. The functor is definitionally positive, and its inverse on objects and maps is definitionally internal Hom. The unit is currying of the tensor identity: equiv_apply at the identity slice gives coevaluation x,y ↦ x tensor y. Applying equiv to its inverse at the identity gives evaluation phi tensor y ↦ phi(y). Replace the endpoint HEq witnesses by equalities and use these formulas. Equivalences preserve finite limits and colimits and are additive in the abelian categories. scalarTensorLeftUnitor gives the required coefficient-unit isomorphism, and scalarTensorLeftUnitor_tmul proves its exact multiplication normalization. These data fill every field of Twisting with no remaining hole in the item.
